# Data

<!-- Describe input coverage, exclusions, units, and source versions with inline R. -->

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "0_setup.R"))
dt <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "compiled-data.rds"))
```

# Analysis

## Prepare

Response and projected coordinates (km). Keep true zeros.

If Step 1 acquired a broader reporting polygon and added a `region` field, filter that field to the model-domain label here before constructing the mesh. Do not remove the broader stations during survey qualification or data-overview compilation.

```{r prepare, eval=params$refit_model}
dt <- dt |>
  dplyr::rename(lon = longitudestart, lat = latitudestart, year = startyear) |>
  dplyr::mutate(value = .data[[response_col]], month = as.integer(month)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))

dt <- sdmTMB::add_utm_columns(dt, ll_names = c("lon", "lat"), utm_crs = dt_crs)  # X, Y in km
```

## Mesh

```{r, eval=params$refit_model}
#| label: fig-fit-mesh
#| fig-cap: "Model mesh and sampling locations in the configured projection."
mesh <- sdmTMB::make_mesh(dt, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = cfg$MESH_CUTOFF_KM)
if (isTRUE(cfg$BARRIER)) {
  ensure_packages("sdmTMBextra")   # installed on demand; see R/0_setup.R
  land <- ggOceanMaps::basemap_data(data = dt, crs = dt_crs)$shapefiles$land
  mesh <- sdmTMBextra::add_barrier_mesh(mesh, land, proj_scaling = 1000)
}
plot_mesh(mesh, crs = dt_crs, data = dt)
```

<!-- Describe the supported finding and refer to @fig-fit-mesh. Confirm caption units, sample size, and interval definitions against the generated result. -->

## Fit

Default formula `value ~ 0 + geartype + s(month) + s(depth)` (temperature off by default). `geartype` stays in when >1 major gear type is present, or whenever a single set gear width is used.

```{r fit, eval=params$refit_model}
has_multiple_gears <- dplyr::n_distinct(dt$geartype) > 1
# `data = dt` sizes the smooth bases to what the survey actually sampled — a series covering
# three months cannot support the default `s(month)` basis and fails with an opaque mgcv error.
form <- build_formula(cfg, has_multiple_gears, data = dt)
form

# Years the survey skipped: an `ar1`/`rw` field assumes evenly spaced steps, and a gap makes
# sdmTMB warn about irregular time spacing and can leave the fit grinding for a very long time.
extra_time <- setdiff(seq(min(dt$year), max(dt$year)), unique(dt$year))

fit <- sdmTMB::sdmTMB(
  form, data = dt, mesh = mesh,
  family = model_family,
  spatial = "on", spatiotemporal = cfg$SPATIOTEMPORAL, time = "year",
  extra_time = if (length(extra_time)) extra_time else NULL,
  control = sdmTMB::sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 2)
)
saveRDS(fit, file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
```

```{r load-fit, eval=!params$refit_model}
fit <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
```

```{r sanity}
sdmTMB::sanity(fit)
```

If `sanity()` flags problems (large gradients, non-PD Hessian, range > domain), simplify — coarser mesh, drop a smooth, or change the spatiotemporal structure — rather than pressing on.

## Prediction grid

```{r grid, eval=params$recompute_grid}
region <- make_survey_prediction_region(dt, crs = dt_crs)
grid   <- make_prediction_grid(region, resolution = grid_side_size, max_depth = cfg$MAX_DEPTH)
grid   <- tidyr::crossing(as.data.frame(grid), year = sort(unique(dt$year)))
grid$geartype <- levels(factor(dt$geartype))[1]   # reference gear
grid$month    <- 8L                               # reference month
saveRDS(grid, file.path(out_dir, "prediction-grid.rds"))
```

```{r load-grid, eval=!params$recompute_grid}
grid <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "prediction-grid.rds"))
```

## Predict and index

```{r}
#| label: fig-fit-index
#| fig-cap: "Estimated annual index. The line represents the estimate and the shaded interval spans the returned lower and upper limits."
pred  <- predict(fit, newdata = grid, return_tmb_object = TRUE)
index <- sdmTMB::get_index(pred, bias_correct = params$bias_correct, area = grid_cell_area_nmi2)
saveRDS(index, file.path(out_dir, "index-total.rds"))

ggplot2::ggplot(index, ggplot2::aes(year, est)) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Index")
```

<!-- Describe the supported finding and refer to @fig-fit-index. Confirm caption units, sample size, and interval definitions against the generated result. -->

## Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: fig-fit-diagnostics
#| fig-cap: "Diagnostics of the first model: residual quantiles, mean predictions, the spatial random field, and fixed effects."
plot_residual_qq(fit)
plot_prediction_map(pred, crs = dt_crs, column = "est", type = "mean")
plot_random_field(pred, crs = dt_crs, field = "omega")
plot_fixed_effects(fit)
```

<!-- Describe the supported finding and refer to @fig-fit-diagnostics. Confirm caption units, sample size, and interval definitions against the generated result. -->

If the simple model is sane and the index is plausible, proceed to Step 3 (`index-validate-model`). Record the mesh cutoff, formula, and family in `ai/memory/`.
